training_contract: Freeze existing context/full models. Generate context raw scores by 3-fold USER cross-fitting on inner train; fit each fold transformer only on that fold's training users. Fixed fold tree counts come from the existing context model's inner-validation checkpoint, never the held-out fold labels. Learn an ad-only binary LightGBM correction with OOF raw scores as init_score. Select correction checkpoint on inner validation with the frozen full-inner-train context model as offset. No test access.
prediction_contract: ad_offset=sigmoid(context_raw+alpha*ad_correction_raw). ad_mean_preserved uses the same correction but solves one common intercept per complete impression so mean probability equals frozen context probability. full_rank_graft is a diagnostic control that reuses the frozen full-feature raw score as the ranking donor, with the same mean constraint; it trains no new ranking model. Every output uses explicit context offset at prediction time.
selection_rule: For each policy select one common alpha minimizing mean inner-validation LogLoss across all 3 seeds; ties prefer smaller alpha. Include alpha=0 as exact context-only fallback. Freeze all choices before loading outer validation. No outer-driven retraining or alpha selection.
evaluation_contract: Same tie-averaged NDCG@5, impression-macro positive-negative pair accuracy, all-row LogLoss/AUC and randomized-display subgroup as the parent experiment. Report paired whole-user bootstrap of seed-mean differences vs context and full. LogLoss/NDCG are primary outcomes; AUC is separately reported. Strict all-three point improvement requires LogLoss lower, AUC higher, NDCG higher than context; do not imply uncertainty-adjusted success from point estimates.
limitations: OOF context models use 2/3 of inner train; deployment context uses all inner train, so offset distribution shift remains possible. Ad-only correction cannot learn contextual changes to pairwise ad preference. Mean-preserved inference requires all candidates of one impression before top-k; it depends on the candidate set and is not a drop-in independent-row predictor. Preserving a predicted mean is not preserving the true CTR or guaranteeing LogLoss improvement.
test_policy: Previously used development data, not a fresh independent holdout. Never open original test. No online CTR claim or production promotion. Keep all existing artifacts and aliases unchanged.
